item.title: REDS VS DONCASTER ROVERS | BARNSLEY HOSPICE TAKEOVER DAY
item.description: The South Yorkshire derby against Doncaster Rovers is our dedicated Barnsley Hospice Takeover Day! Barnsley Hospice is the beating heart of our town, providing specialist palliative and end of life care to the people of Barnsley and those close to them. As a charity, the hospice needs to raise roughly two-thirds of its yearly income through fundraising activities. item.title: BARNSLEY VS BRADFORD SELECTED FOR SKY SPORTS+ COVERAGE
item.description: Our Sky Bet League One fixture against Bradford City at Oakwell will now kick-off at 12:30pm on Saturday 18 April. The Reds' penultimate home game of the 2025/26 campaign will be broadcasted on Sky Sports +. The reverse fixture saw the Reds earn a point at the University of Bradford stadium, thanks to Reyes Cleary's spectacular long-range strike and Patrick Kelly's first game for the Club.

item.title: OWEN GOODMAN SELECTED FOR CANADA SQUAD
item.description: Goalkeeper Owen Goodman has been called up to the Canada Men’s National Team squad for their upcoming March international fixtures. Canada will host Iceland and Tunisia in Toronto later this month as part of their preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with the matches among the final opportunities to play on home soil ahead of the tournament. Everyone at Barnsley FC wishes Owen the best of luck and congratulates him on his international recognition.

item.title: HOW THE REDS LINEUP TO FACE DONCASTER ROVERS
item.description: Team news is proudly sponsored by Copier Systems Limited.FixturesBarnsley Vs. Doncaster Rovers - Sat, Mar 21 2026, 15:00Conor Hourihane makes two changes from the side that drew to Wigan Athletic in midweek to take on Doncaster Rovers this afternoon at Oakwell. Tennai Watson makes his first Reds start since the defeat to Wycombe Wanderers, with Adam Phillips taking his place in midfield to replace Maël de Gevigney and Vimal Yoganathan. item.title: REDS ROVERS REPORT
